# Purpose {.unnumbered .unlisted}

- Visually compare manual segment labels with the two-step automated classification (tone/trill model + fixed thresholds) on spectrograms of 30 randomly chosen songs

</div>

```{r load packages, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

```

# Two-step labels

The two-step labels are obtained as described in `automated_segment_classification.qmd`:

1. **Tone vs. trill**: xgboost model on the contour and audio features. Predictions come from grouped 5-fold cross-validation, so each song is labelled by a model that did not see its song type during training
2. **Sub-categories**: fixed thresholds on a single measurement
    - Trills: fast (F) if trill period < 8.5 ms, medium (M) if 8.5 - 15 ms, slow (S) if > 15 ms
    - Tones: descending (D) if slope < -5 kHz/s, flat (P) if -5 to 5 kHz/s, ascending (U) if > 5 kHz/s

```{r two step labels}

# features created by automated_segment_classification.qmd
X <- read.csv("./data/processed/segment_classifier/segment_features_audio.csv")
non_feat <- c("ID", "lek.song.type", "Category", "start", "end")
feat <- setdiff(names(X), non_feat)
Xm <- X
for (v in feat) Xm[[v]][is.na(Xm[[v]])] <- -999

# grouped folds (whole lek song types held out)
set.seed(1)
types <- unique(X$lek.song.type)
fold <- setNames(sample(rep(1:5, length.out = length(types))), types)[X$lek.song.type]

y <- as.integer(X$Category %in% c("F", "M", "S"))
w <- ifelse(y == 1, sqrt(sum(y == 0) / sum(y == 1)), 1)
X$p_trill <- NA
for (f in 1:5) {
  tr <- fold != f
  m <- xgb.train(params = list(eta = 0.03, max_depth = 6, subsample = 0.8, colsample_bytree = 0.6,
                               min_child_weight = 2, objective = "binary:logistic", nthread = 8),
                 data = xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(Xm[tr, feat]), label = y[tr], weight = w[tr]),
                 nrounds = 800, verbose = 0)
  X$p_trill[!tr] <- predict(m, as.matrix(Xm[!tr, feat]))
}

X$trill_period_ms <- 1000 / X$osc_rate
X$two_step <- ifelse(X$p_trill > 0.5,
                     ifelse(X$trill_period_ms < 8.5, "F", ifelse(X$trill_period_ms < 15, "M", "S")),
                     ifelse(X$slope < -5, "D", ifelse(X$slope < 5, "P", "U")))

# overall agreement
data.frame(segments = nrow(X), agreement = round(mean(X$two_step == X$Category), 3))

table(manual = X$Category, two_step = X$two_step)

```

# Spectrograms

Each panel shows the spectrogram of one song with the tailored frequency contour (white line) and segment boundaries (dashed lines). The two strips at the top show the **manual** label (upper strip) and the **two-step** label (lower strip) of each segment; segments where they agree are shaded green and those where they disagree red. Manual W segments (a single wide frequency sweep) were converted to ascending tones (U) in `automated_segment_classification.qmd`, which also reassigns a few segments that were annotated with the wrong song. The value below the two-step label is the trill period (ms) for trills or the frequency slope (kHz/s) for tones, i.e. the measurement used to assign the sub-category.

```{r plotting function}

contours <- read.csv("./data/raw/segment_classification/seltailor_output.csv")
ff_cols <- grep("^ff", names(contours))
wave <- readWave("./data/raw/segment_classification/contour-degradation_325_songs.wav")
sr <- wave@samp.rate

cat_cols <- setNames(viridis(6, option = "H", begin = 0.05, end = 0.95), c("D", "U", "P", "F", "M", "S"))

plot_song <- function(id, margin = 0.01, flim = c(1, 11)) {
  d <- X[X$ID == id, ]; d <- d[order(d$start), ]
  ct <- contours[contours$song.type == id, ]
  t0 <- max(0, min(ct$start, d$start) - margin); t1 <- max(ct$end, d$end) + margin
  clip <- cutw(wave, f = sr, from = t0, to = t1, output = "Wave")
  sp <- spectro(clip, f = sr, wl = 256, ovlp = 90, plot = FALSE, flim = c(0, 13))
  amp <- sp$amp; amp[amp < -45] <- -45
  tms <- (sp$time) * 1000                                   # ms from clip start
  # frequency axis with room for the label strips above the spectrogram
  strip_lo <- flim[2]; strip_mid <- flim[2] + 1.2; strip_hi <- flim[2] + 2.4
  par(mar = c(4, 4, 2.5, 1))
  plot(NA, xlim = range(tms), ylim = c(flim[1], strip_hi), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i",
       xlab = "Time (ms)", ylab = "Frequency (kHz)", yaxt = "n",
       main = sprintf("%s   (agreement: %d of %d segments)", id, sum(d$Category == d$two_step), nrow(d)),
       cex.main = 1)
  axis(2, at = seq(ceiling(flim[1]), flim[2], 2))
  fsel <- sp$freq >= flim[1] & sp$freq <= flim[2]
  image(tms, sp$freq[fsel], t(amp[fsel, ]), col = gray.colors(40, start = 1, end = 0), add = TRUE, useRaster = TRUE)

  # tailored contour
  tt <- seq(ct$start, ct$end, length.out = length(ff_cols))
  lines((tt - t0) * 1000, unlist(ct[, ff_cols]), col = "white", lwd = 4)
  lines((tt - t0) * 1000, unlist(ct[, ff_cols]), col = "#FF8C00", lwd = 1.5)

  # segments and label strips
  xs <- (d$start - t0) * 1000; xe <- (d$end - t0) * 1000
  abline(v = c(xs, tail(xe, 1)), lty = 2, col = "gray30")
  rect(min(tms), strip_lo, max(tms), strip_hi, col = "white", border = NA)
  # green = agreement, red = disagreement
  fill <- ifelse(d$Category != d$two_step, "#F4C7C3", "#E6F2E6")
  rect(xs, strip_mid, xe, strip_hi, col = fill, border = "gray40")
  rect(xs, strip_lo, xe, strip_mid, col = fill, border = "gray40")
  meas <- ifelse(d$two_step %in% c("F", "M", "S"), sprintf("%.1f", d$trill_period_ms), sprintf("%.0f", d$slope))
  cx <- ifelse(xe - xs < 0.03 * diff(range(tms)), 0.7, 1)
  text((xs + xe) / 2, strip_mid + 0.6, d$Category, col = cat_cols[d$Category], font = 2, cex = cx)
  text((xs + xe) / 2, strip_lo + 0.78, d$two_step, col = cat_cols[d$two_step], font = 2, cex = cx)
  text((xs + xe) / 2, strip_lo + 0.3, meas, cex = 0.55 * cx, col = "gray20")
  mtext(c("manual", "two-step"), side = 2, at = c(strip_mid + 0.6, strip_lo + 0.6), las = 1, line = 0.3, cex = 0.7, adj = 1)
  box()
}

```

```{r select songs}

set.seed(42)
songs <- sample(unique(X$ID), 30)

# songs sorted by lek song type so renditions of the same song type appear together
songs <- songs[order(sub("^[0-9]+-", "", songs))]

```

```{r spectrograms, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 4.2, results = "asis"}

for (id in songs) {
  cat("\n\n## ", id, "\n\n", sep = "")
  plot_song(id)
  cat("\n\n")
}

```
